title: French Omelette
description: A classic French omelette made with gluten-free ingredients, perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together until well mixed.
Season the eggs with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat the butter in a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Once the butter has melted, tilt the pan to ensure the surface is evenly coated.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan and let it cook for about 2 minutes, until the edges start to set.
Add the shredded cheese to one half of the omelette and fold the other half over to cover it.
Cook for another minute, until the cheese is melted and the eggs are cooked through.
Slide the omelette onto a plate and serve hot.
If using, place the flaky french pastry crust on top of the omelette for added crunch.
